note: Both sets contain the same nine claims and share the same four detail-callout misbindings (A4/A1 and B4/B1 are swapped relative to the sheet, and the E6 callout is replaced by the title fragment 'T.O. STEEL'). The only substantive difference is the edge-radius note: Set A keeps the full condition 'around edges of openings in beams', while Set B truncates it to 'around edges', losing where the radius applies. Set A is therefore slightly more faithful, with all other claims equal.
remarks: Shared pattern: both extractions pair detail callouts with the wrong titles. Per the sheet, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2 = A4, GRID 3 = B4, GRID 4 = C4, GRID 5 = D5, FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5 = B1, ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5 = C1, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6 = A1, ROOF BEAM @ GRID 2,3,4,5 = E6; the quotes backing the four swapped claims are not supported by the page. Both also omit the ø 3" opening diameter shown in the W8X13 roof beam details (C1, E6) and all opening size/spacing dimensions, and both use the title fragment 'T.O. STEEL' as a condition for the E6 beam instead of its callout. The deciding difference between the sets is small.
